domain: harmful algal bloom in a water reservoir

Agricultural nutrient runoff.provides: diffuse origin with no single responsible party, loading concentrated after rainfall

Sewage treatment discharge.requires: a consented outfall to the reservoir catchment
Sewage treatment discharge.provides: a single identifiable operator, continuous rather than event-driven loading

Internal phosphorus release from sedimen.requires: anoxic conditions at the reservoir bed
Internal phosphorus release from sedimen.provides: loading with no external input at all, unresponsive to any catchment measure

Prolonged warm still weather.requires: an extended heatwave over the water body
Prolonged warm still weather.provides: stratification and surface accumulation, no change in nutrient supply whatsoever

Surface cyanobacterial scum.requires: buoyant colonies accumulating at the surface
Surface cyanobacterial scum.provides: visible discoloration, wind-driven accumulation on one shore, toxin production possible

Dispersed subsurface growth.requires: cells distributed through the water column
Dispersed subsurface growth.provides: no visible surface sign at all, detectable only by sampling

Toxin-producing strain.requires: a strain carrying the toxin genes
Toxin-producing strain.provides: hepatotoxin or neurotoxin in the raw water, a public health rather than aesthetic problem

Non-toxic nuisance species.requires: a bloom-forming species without toxin genes
Non-toxic nuisance species.provides: taste and odour complaints, no health risk of any kind

Routine laboratory sampling.requires: a scheduled sampling round and a laboratory
Routine laboratory sampling.provides: species identification and toxin assay, results days later

In-situ fluorescence probe.requires: an instrument moored in the reservoir
In-situ fluorescence probe.provides: continuous pigment concentration, no species or toxin information

Satellite surface imagery.requires: cloud-free conditions and a large water body
Satellite surface imagery.provides: mapping of surface accumulation extent, blind below the surface

Public complaint.provides: rapid unstructured signal, only for visible or smellable blooms

Change abstraction depth.provides: withdrawal below a surface accumulation, no help against a dispersed bloom

Activated carbon dosing at treatment.provides: removal of toxins and taste compounds, cost and sludge burden

Algicide application to the reservoir.requires: regulatory permission and a treatment vessel
Algicide application to the reservoir.provides: rapid cell kill, release of intracellular toxin as the cells lyse

Catchment nutrient controls.requires: landowner agreement and years of time
Catchment nutrient controls.provides: durable reduction of loading, no effect on the bloom under way
